<section class="section" style="padding-top: 6rem;">
  <div class="section-label">About Me</div>
  <h2>The longer version.</h2>

  <div class="about-grid">
    <div class="about-text">
      <p>
        I'm Gaurang — pronounced <em style="color: var(--accent);">Gaw-rung</em>. 
        I spent seven years building production software, and at some point I got 
        genuinely curious about what happens when engineering meets machine learning. 
        So I decided to find out properly, which is how I ended up at UBC doing a Master of Data Science.
      </p>
      <p>
        My engineering background is in Java microservices, CI/CD, and keeping systems running 
        under pressure. At UKG I grew from developer to lead, owning core services, 
        modernizing infrastructure, and mentoring junior engineers through the process. 
        Before that, Ericsson and Apple put me in environments where the margin for 
        error was essentially zero. At Ericsson I worked close to hardware, converting 
        MATLAB prototypes into production C++ for radio firmware deployed at live customer 
        sites. At Apple I optimized chipset drivers and cut automated test runtimes from 65 seconds 
        to 17 — small numbers with outsized impact on the team's velocity.
      </p>
      <p>
        What MDS has added is the ability to think statistically and work across the 
        full ML stack — from wrangling messy data and training models to 
        building reproducible pipelines and deploying interactive tools. 
        I care about models that work in production, not just ones that 
        look good in a notebook.
      </p>
      <p>
        For my capstone project, I partnered with  
        <strong>Educational Testing Service (ETS)</strong>, to build an equity-focused 
        education dashboard processing over 1.7 million student records across 
        80+ countries. It's the kind of work where the technical decisions 
        directly shape how policymakers understand global education outcomes.
      </p>
      <p style="color: var(--text-secondary); margin-top: 2rem; padding-top: 2rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);">
        I'm open to ML/AI engineering and data science roles — 
        hybrid or remote. If you're working on something interesting, 
        <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gaurang-ahuja/" style="color: var(--accent);">let's talk</a>.
